ext.description: REST Client, maintained: send HTTP requests from a .http file and read the response in the editor. No account, no cloud, no paywall, no telemetry. Same format and settings as always, plus tests, assertions, a terminal runner, the JetBrains format, streaming and tools for agents.
cfg.defaultHeaders: If particular headers are omitted in request headers, these will be added as headers for each request.
cfg.requestNameAsResponseTabTitle: Show request name as the response tab title
cfg.excludeHostsForProxy: Excluded hosts when using using proxy settings
cfg.fontSize: Controls the font size in pixels used in the response preview. When set to `0`, the value of `#editor.fontSize#` is used.
cfg.fontFamily: Controls the font family used in the response preview
cfg.fontWeight: Controls the font weight used in the response preview
cfg.environmentVariables: Sets the environments and custom variables belongs to it, especially the special environment name '$shared' is used to create variables shared across all the individual environments (e.g., `{"$shared": {"version": "v1"}, "production": {"host": "api.example.com"}, "sandbox":{"host":"sandbox.api.example.com"}}`)
cfg.mimeAndFileExtensionMapping: Sets the custom mapping of mime type and file extension of saved response body (e.g., `{"application/atom+xml": "xml"}`)
cfg.previewResponseInUntitledDocument: Preview response in untitled document if set to true, otherwise displayed in html view
cfg.oidcScopes: Scopes to be used by the OIDC client, default: [openid profile email]
cfg.oidcCertificates: Certificate paths for Oidc callback server
cfg.certificates: Certificate paths by host. Host keys are case-insensitive and support host and port wildcards. Paths can be absolute or relative to the workspace. See [SSL Client Certificates](https://github.com/vscode-restclient/vscode-restclient/blob/master/README.md#ssl-client-certificates) for full matching, precedence and conflict rules.
cfg.certificates.host: Certificate paths for this host key, e.g., `example.com`, `example.com:8443` or `**.example.com:*`. `*.example.com` matches exactly one additional label; `**.example.com` matches one or more. Neither matches `example.com` itself. `:*` matches any port or no port; a numeric port matches only that port, and a key without a port matches only URLs without a port.
cfg.certificates.invalidKey: Invalid wildcard host key. Use a whole leading label (*. or **.) or a wildcard port (:*), e.g., *.example.com:8443 or **.example.com:*. Schemes and paths are not supported.
cfg.certificates.cert: Path to the public X.509 certificate. Absolute paths are supported. Relative paths use the workspace folder, or the HTTP file's directory when no workspace folder is available.
cfg.certificates.key: Path to the private key. Absolute paths are supported. Relative paths use the workspace folder, or the HTTP file's directory when no workspace folder is available.
cfg.certificates.pfx: Path to the PKCS #12 certificate. Absolute paths are supported. Relative paths use the workspace folder, or the HTTP file's directory when no workspace folder is available.
cfg.certificates.passphrase: Passphrase for the private key or PKCS #12 certificate. Optional.
cfg.suppressResponseBodyContentTypeValid: Suppress response body content type validation
cfg.disableHighlightResponseBodyForLarge: Controls whether to highlight response body for response whose size is larger than limit specified by `rest-client.largeResponseSizeLimitInMB`
cfg.disableAddingHrefLinkForLargeRespons: Controls whether to add href link in previewed response for response whose size is larger than limit specified by `rest-client.largeResponseSizeLimitInMB`
cfg.largeResponseBodySizeLimitInMB: Set the response body size threshold of MB to identify whether a response is a so-called 'large response', only used when `rest-client.disableHighlightResponseBodyForLargeResponse` and/or `rest-client.disableAddingHrefLinkForLargeResponse` is set to true
cfg.previewResponsePanelTakeFocus: Preview response panel will take focus after receiving response.
cfg.formParamEncodingStrategy: Form param encoding strategy for request body of `x-www-form-urlencoded`.
cfg.addRequestBodyLineIndentationAroundB: Add line indentation around brackets(`{}`, `<>`, `[]`) in request body when pressing enter.
cfg.decodeEscapedUnicodeCharacters: Decode escaped unicode characters in response body.
cfg.logLevel: The verbosity of logging in the REST output panel
cfg.enableSendRequestCodeLens: Enable/disable sending request CodeLens in request file
cfg.enableCustomVariableReferencesCodeLe: Enable/disable custom variable references CodeLens in request file
cfg.useContentDispositionFilename: Enable/disable using filename from 'content-disposition' header, when saving response body
